ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the central and medial surfaces, with 20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottle at the distal tip of the right lobe; elongated white-to-grey transition band along the proximal leading edge of the left lobe; the remainder of the fluke is a uniform low-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; the vertex is partially occluded by water surface turbulence, but the visible upper lobes form an angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration on the right lobe with multiple high-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 6-8 distinct protrusions); left lobe exhibits lower-frequency, rounded serration patterns.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curve resulting in upward-tapered, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dark vertical linear disruptions visible within the high-intensity white patch on the right distal lobe, consistent with rake mark morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmentation and scarring localized on the distal end of the right lobe; irregular notch-like deformities along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced inward-curving terminal tip on the left lobe, creating a hook-like silhouette.
